## A Career with NO Student Debt! Learn About VNB’s Finance Career & Leadership Academy


Virginia National Bank has created a unique opportunity for high school Juniors & Seniors with the FREE **[Finance Career & Leadership Academy](https://www.vnb.com/community/finance-career-leadership-academy)** (FCLA, Academy). The Academy is designed to provide advanced personal finance and employment readiness training AND a path to career opportunities in banking without student debt.


If you think this opportunity could be for you or your child, we invite you to an informational session on Tuesday, October 20th from 6:30-8PM and Thursday, November 5th from 6:30-8PM at Virginia National Bank’s Pantops location in Charlottesville. Learn effective communication, employment readiness, and strategies to help you get ahead. Listen to our **[recent podcast](https://www.buzzsprout.com/2632965/episodes/19912109)** about the FCLA program with VNB’s President of Educational Programs, Meghan Crider.


Please RSVP to **[\[email protected\]](https://www.vnb.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#cda8bba8a3b9be8dbba3afe3aea2a0)** to attend one of our informational sessions.
